title: Critique: what it is like without a real state is fake

statements.text: If agony that does not exist matters just as real agony does, the what it is like the theory explains is not the kind that matters. Saying the conscious state is a nonexistent intentional object is coherent only by an implausible view of how something nonexistent can occur and matter.

sources.quote: If they say this, they reveal that the what-it-is-like-ness they invoke is fake.
If a state of being conscious of agony is supposed to matter equally whether it exists or not, the supposed theory of consciousness is worthless.
it is a mystery how something that does not exist can occur and matter in that way
